en: Bachelor of Science in Food Technology is a four-year degree program design to develop professionals in food technology. The program focuses on a mix of pure and applied science, engineering, business, and entrepreneurial skills. It aims to produce professionals who have the capacity to apply the science and technology and related fields of study in post-harvest handling, preparation, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, and marketing of food to ensure food and nutrition security, quality, environmental sustainability and the well-being of individuals, families and communities. The program also aims to promote continued excellence in food science education.

Tumong niini ang pag-produce og mga propesyonal nga adunay kapasidad sa paggamit sa siyensya ug teknolohiya ug uban pang may kalabotan nga larangan sa post-harvest handling, preparation, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, ug marketing sa pagkaon aron masiguro ang food ug nutrition security, kalidad, environmental sustainability, ug kaayohan sa mga indibidwal, pamilya, ug komunidad. Ang programa usab nagtumong sa pagpalambo sa padayon nga kahusayan sa food science education.

en: The Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing is the study and use of concepts, principles, and techniques of computing in the design and development of multimedia products and solutions. It includes various applications such as in science, entertainment, education, simulations and advertising.

The program enables the students to be knowledgeable of the whole pipeline of Digital Animation projects. The students will acquire the independence and creative competencies to articulate project design and requirements of new projects, not necessarily based on standard templates.

The Digital Animation Technology major is the study and application of fundamental and advanced theories and techniques in 2D and 3D animation, use and development for advancement of animation technologies and production of commercially acceptable content and viable solutions for different platforms such as broadcast, web and mobile cast.

Ang programa naghatag sa estudyante og kahibalo sa tibuok proseso sa Digital Animation projects. Ang mga estudyante makabaton og independence ug creative competencies aron ma-articulate ang project design ug requirements sa bag-ong proyekto, dili lang base sa standard templates.

Ang Digital Animation Technology major mao ang pagtuon ug aplikasyon sa fundamental ug advanced nga teorya ug teknik sa 2D ug 3D animation, paggamit ug pag-develop alang sa pag-uswag sa animation technologies ug paghimo sa commercially acceptable content ug viable solutions para sa lain-laing platforms sama sa broadcast, web, ug mobile cast.

Kung kinahanglan ka mag-absent, kinahanglan maghatag ka ug valid nga rason ug supporting documents para ma-approve.
Timan-i nga kung maka-accumulate ka ug 7 ka absences, moresulta kini sa FDA (Failure Due to Absences).

en: You may add or drop subjects during the official add/drop period at the Registrar's Office.
To help you find your way, I have provided a map you can use to navigate to the office.
ceb: Pwede ka makadugang o makatangtang ug subject sulod sa official add/drop period sa Registrar’s Office.
Aron mas sayon nimo makita ang lugar, naghatag ko ug mapa nga pwede nimo gamiton padulong sa opisina.

en: Intramurals are sports competitions held within the university.
ceb: Ang intramurals kay sports competition sulod sa unibersidad.

en: At the end of the semester, final examinations are conducted, grades are submitted, and clearance processing takes place.
ceb: Sa katapusan sa semester, naay final exams, pag-submit sa grades, ug clearance processing.

en: A minor subject supports your major field of study and helps build general knowledge.
ceb: Ang minor subject kay support sa imong major ug naghatag ug dugang kahibalo.

en: Yes, freshmen are allowed to participate in intramurals.
ceb: Oo, pwede moapil ang freshmen sa intramurals.

en: If a group member becomes inactive, it is best to inform your instructor about the situation as early as possible.
ceb: Kung naay inactive nga group member, mas maayo nga i-inform dayon ang instructor sa sitwasyon.

en: The use of mobile phones during class depends on the classroom rules set by the instructor.
ceb: Ang paggamit sa cellphone sulod sa klase depende sa classroom rules nga gi-set sa instructor.

en: Overload refers to taking more subjects than the regular academic load.
ceb: Ang overload kay pagkuha ug mas daghang subjects kaysa sa normal nga academic load.

en: For class-related concerns, you should talk to your instructor first.
ceb: Para sa mga concern sa klase, makigstorya una sa imong instructor.

en: If you are feeling stressed or overwhelmed, consider seeking help from your advisers, counselors, or trusted university staff.
ceb: Kung gibati nimo nga stressed o overwhelmed ka, mangayo ug tabang sa adviser, counselor, o kasaligan nga staff sa unibersidad.

en: The BukSU Seal is the “sacred” and official emblem of Bukidnon State University, used primarily for high level academic and legal documents like diplomas and transcripts.
Each element within the seal has a specific meaning:
The Lamp: Symbolizes the light of truth and the university's commitment to academic, moral, and spiritual enlightenment.
The Book: Represents knowledge and the historical record of the institution.
The Adult and Child: Signifies the university's roots in teacher training, showing a teacher guiding a child toward a better future.
The Mountains: Represents the university's location in Bukidnon and symbolizes the heights of wisdom.
The Shield: Serves as the base for all symbols, representing education as a person's defense or shield against life's challenges.
Laurel Leaves: Represents the excellence the university strives for in its graduates and faculty.
Sheaf of Palay and Flask: These symbolize the university's goal of progress and prosperity for the region.
ceb: Ang BukSU Seal mao ang “sagrado” ug opisyal nga simbolo sa Bukidnon State University, nga kasagarang gigamit alang sa high-level academic ug legal nga mga dokumento sama sa diplomas ug transcripts.
Ang matag elemento sulod sa seal adunay espesipikong kahulogan:
Ang Lampara: Nagsimbolo sa kahayag sa kamatuoran ug sa komitment sa unibersidad sa akademiko, moral, ug espiritwal nga kahayag.
Ang Libro: Nagrepresentar sa kahibalo ug sa historikal nga rekord sa institusyon.
Ang Hamtong ug Bata: Nagpasabot sa gigikanan sa unibersidad sa teacher training, nga nagpakita sa usa ka magtutudlo nga naggiya sa bata padulong sa mas maayong kaugmaon.
Ang Kabukiran: Nagrepresentar sa lokasyon sa unibersidad sa Bukidnon ug nagsimbolo sa kataas sa kaalam.
Ang Panagang (Shield): Mao ang base sa tanang simbolo, nga nagpasabot sa edukasyon isip panagang sa tawo batok sa mga hagit sa kinabuhi.
Ang Dahon sa Laurel: Nagrepresentar sa kahusayan nga gipaningkamotan sa unibersidad para sa iyang mga gradwado ug faculty.
Ang Bugkos sa Palay ug Flask: Kini nagsimbolo sa tumong sa unibersidad alang sa pag-uswag ug kauswagan sa rehiyon.

en: Unfortunately I cannot display the full lyrics of the BukSU Hymn due to larg amount of text but i can send you the link, note this is not official link but it contains the lyrics of the BukSU Hymn
https://bukidnononline.com/bukidnon-state-university-hymn/#google_vignette
ceb: Pasensya na dili nako ma display ang full lyrics sa BukSU Hymn tungod sa kadaghan sa teksto pero pwede nako ipadala ang link, note nga dili ni official link pero naglakip kini sa lyrics sa BukSU Hymn
https://bukidnononline.com/bukidnon-state-university-hymn/#google_vignette

en: Academic overload for seniors allows graduating students to take additional subjects in order to complete their program on time.
ceb: Ang overload para sa seniors kay pagkuha ug extra subjects aron makagraduate dayon.

en: Some colleges offer board examination review programs or support sessions for students.
ceb: Ang ubang mga college naghatag ug review programs o support sessions para sa board exam.

en: Eating inside classrooms depends on the rules set by the instructor.
ceb: Ang pagkaon sulod sa classroom depende sa rules sa instructor.

en: A licensure examination is a national exam required to legally practice certain professions.
ceb: Ang licensure examination kay national exam nga gikinahanglan para makapraktis sa pipila ka profession.

en: A mock board exam is a practice examination designed to prepare students for the actual licensure examination.
ceb: Ang mock board exam kay practice exam nga gituyo aron andamon ang mga estudyante para sa tinuod nga board exam.

en: Application approval may take time due to the high volume of applications being reviewed by the Admission staff.
In most cases, applications are approved about one week before the scheduled examination date.
However, processing times may vary and approval may occur closer to the exam date in some situations.
Please continue monitoring your admission account and allow additional time for the review process.
ceb: Ang approval sa application mahimong modugay tungod sa kadaghan sa applications nga gi-review sa Admission staff.
Sa kasagaran, ang applications ma-aprubahan mga usa ka semana sa wala pa ang exam date.
Apan, ang processing time mahimong magkalain-lain ug usahay ma-aprubahan mas duol sa exam date.
Palihog padayon sa pag-monitor sa imong admission account ug magpailub samtang naghulat sa approval.

en: On-the-job training (OJT) provides students with real-world work experience related to their course.
ceb: Ang on-the-job training (OJT) naghatag ug real-world nga work experience nga konektado sa imong kurso.

en: The BukSU Entrance Examination cannot be rescheduled once your exam date has been assigned.
If you are unable to attend your scheduled exam, you may need to wait for the next admission cycle.
I recommend ensuring your availability on your assigned exam date to avoid delays in your admission.
ceb: Dili ma-reschedule ang BukSU Entrance Examination kung naa na kay assigned exam date.
Kung dili ka makatunga sa imong scheduled exam, mahimo nga kinahanglan ka maghulat sa sunod nga admission cycle.
Mas maayo nga siguroon ang imong availability sa imong exam date aron malikayan ang delay sa imong admission.

en: TES allowance release may take time due to multiple verification and approval processes.
This includes fund release, eligibility validation, and billing verification.
The process involves coordination between DBM, CHED, and the university.
Any missing documents or strict auditing procedures may further delay the release.
I recommend regularly checking with your scholarship coordinator for updates.
ceb: Ang pag-release sa TES allowance mahimong modugay tungod sa daghang proseso sa verification ug approval.
Lakip niini ang pag-release sa pondo, pag-validate sa eligibility, ug pag-verify sa billing documents.
Ang proseso naglakip sa koordinasyon tali sa DBM, CHED, ug sa unibersidad.
Ang kulang nga dokumento o hugot nga auditing mahimong makapahinay sa pag-release sa allowance.
Mas maayo nga mangutana sa inyong scholarship coordinator para sa updates.

en: The official school uniform is required for undergraduate students during regular class days.
Civilian attire is typically allowed on Wednesdays, Saturdays, and Sundays, or when authorized by official announcements.
Formal attire may also be allowed during enrollment periods or official academic activities.
New students are usually given a grace period to prepare their uniforms.
ceb: Ang official school uniform required para sa undergraduate students panahon sa regular class days.
Ang civilian attire kasagaran tugotan matag Miyerkules, Sabado, ug Domingo, o kung adunay official announcement.
Ang formal attire pwede usab panahon sa enrollment o official academic activities.
Ang mga bag-ong estudyante kasagaran hatagan og grace period aron makapangandam sa ilang uniform.

en: Students may apply for TES even if they are applicants of other scholarship programs such as REAP or TABUK.
However, TES qualification policies generally do not allow students to receive multiple government-funded educational assistance benefits simultaneously.
Final eligibility is subject to scholarship guidelines and official verification.
I recommend consulting the Scholarship Office for accurate confirmation regarding your eligibility.
ceb: Ang mga estudyante pwede mag-apply sa TES bisan applicant sila sa ubang scholarship programs sama sa REAP o TABUK.
Apan, base sa scholarship policies, dili kasagaran tugotan nga makadawat og daghang government-funded educational assistance sa parehas nga panahon.
Ang final eligibility magdepende sa scholarship guidelines ug official verification.
Mas maayo nga mangutana sa Scholarship Office aron makakuha og eksaktong impormasyon.

en: If you receive an INC grade, it means you still need to complete the missing requirements for that subject.
If the subject is a prerequisite, you may not be allowed to enroll in the next subject until it is completed.
If the INC is not completed within the allowed period, you may become an irregular student.
ceb: Kung adunay ka INC nga grado, nagpasabot kini nga adunay pa kay kulang nga requirements sa maong subject.
Kung ang subject nga adunay INC mao ang prerequisite, dili ka maka-enroll sa sunod nga subject hangtod makompleto kini.
Kung dili makompleto ang requirements sa tukmang oras, mahimo ka mahimong irregular nga estudyante.

en: BukSU provides on-campus dormitory facilities for students.
Separate dormitories are available for male and female students.
Dormitory policies are strictly implemented to ensure safety and proper accommodation.
I recommend contacting the dormitory office for availability and application requirements.
ceb: Naghatag ang BukSU og on-campus dormitory facilities para sa mga estudyante.
Adunay separate dormitories alang sa lalaki ug babae.
Ang dormitory policies hugot nga ginapatuman aron masiguro ang safety ug proper accommodation.
Mas maayo nga mangutana sa dormitory office alang sa availability ug requirements.

en: Wearing shorts is permitted only during intramural sports competitions, such as wearing a jersey to allow for better movement.
Shorts are also allowed if required for specific academic activities, such as P.E. presentations.
Outside of these specific instances, wearing shorts on campus is strictly prohibited.
ceb: Ang pagsul-ob og shorts gitugotan ra panahon sa intramural sports competitions, sama sa pagsul-ob og jersey aron mas sayon ang lihok.
Gitugotan usab kini kung kinahanglan para sa espesipikong academic activities, sama sa mga P.E. presentations.
Gawas ani nga mga sitwasyon, hugot nga bawal ang pagsul-ob og shorts sulod sa campus.

en: The core values of Bukidnon State University are Excellence, Professionalism, Integrity, Commitment, and Culture Sensitivity.
ceb: Ang mga core values sa Bukidnon State University mao ang Excellence, Professionalism, Integrity, Commitment, ug Culture Sensitivity.

en: You can find all the forms, including the INC form, on the BukSU main website. You can access them directly using this link: https://buksu.edu.ph/downloadable-forms/
ceb: Naa ra sa main website sa BukSU ang tanang forms, apil na ang INC form. I-click lang ni nga link para makuha nimo sila: https://buksu.edu.ph/downloadable-forms/

en: Prerequisite subjects are foundational courses that must be completed before enrolling in more advanced or specialized classes.
Their main purpose is to ensure that students have the necessary knowledge, skills, and preparation to succeed in higher-level courses.
ceb: Ang prerequisite subjects mao ang mga batakang kurso nga kinahanglan una mahuman sa estudyante sa dili pa maka-enroll sa mas advanced o specialized nga mga klase.
Ang ilang tumong mao ang pagsiguro nga ang estudyante adunay igo nga kahibalo, kahanas, ug kahanduraw aron magmalampuson sa mas taas nga lebel sa kurso.

en: ROTC stands for Reserve Officers' Training Corps.
It is a college-based program that provides military training and leadership education to students who may later serve in the armed forces.
ceb: Ang ROTC nagpasabot og Reserve Officers' Training Corps.
Kini usa ka programa sa kolehiyo nga naghatag og military training ug leadership education sa mga estudyante nga mahimong mosilbi sa armed forces sa umaabot.

en: The mission of Bukidnon State University is to develop competitive professionals who are committed to building a sustainable life for all through quality instruction, research, extension, and production.
ceb: Ang misyon sa Bukidnon State University mao ang pagpalambo sa mga kompetitibong propesyonal nga komitado sa pagtukod og malungtarong kinabuhi alang sa tanan pinaagi sa kalidad nga pagtudlo, panukiduki, extension, ug produksyon.

en: The vision of Bukidnon State University is to become a premier institution that produces innovative and ethical leaders for sustainable development.
ceb: Ang bisyon sa Bukidnon State University mao ang mahimong usa ka nangunang institusyon nga nagmugna og mga lider nga inobatibo ug adunay integridad alang sa malungtarong kalamboan.

en: The current president of Bukidnon State University is Dr. Joy Mirasol.
She leads the university in promoting quality education, research, and community service.
ceb: Ang kasamtangang presidente sa Bukidnon State University mao si Dr. Joy Mirasol.
Siya ang nanguna sa unibersidad sa pagpalambo sa kalidad nga edukasyon, panukiduki, ug serbisyo sa komunidad.

en: You can request a Good Moral Certificate from the Office of Student Services.
The standard fee for issuing the certificate is fifty pesos.
ceb: Mahimo nimong pangayoon ang Good Moral Certificate sa Office of Student Services.
Ang bayad sa certificate kay singkwenta pesos.

en: If you receive an FDA, you should immediately approach your instructor and discuss your situation.
Ask about possible options or actions you can take regarding the subject.
Some instructors may allow discussions or provide guidance depending on the circumstances.
ceb: Kung makadawat ka og FDA, kinahanglan nimo dayon duolon ang imong instructor ug istoryahan ang imong sitwasyon.
Pangutan-a sila kung unsa ang posible nimong mahimo bahin sa imong subject.
Ang ubang instructor mahimong mohatag og tambag o guidance depende sa sitwasyon.

en: Students may sometimes be allowed to wear their college shirts depending on official announcements.
In some cases, this is permitted on Thursdays or Fridays.
It is best to stay updated by following the official Bukidnon State University Facebook page for announcements.
ceb: Usahay tugotan ang mga estudyante nga magsul-ob sa ilang college shirt depende sa opisyal nga announcements.
Sa ubang kaso, gitugotan kini kada Huwebes o Biyernes.
Mas maayo nga magpabiling updated pinaagi sa pagsunod sa opisyal nga Facebook page sa Bukidnon State University.

en: To check your enrollment status log in to the BukSU Admission using your student ID and password.
Go to the enrollment or registration section.
Your enrollment status subjects and schedule will appear in your dashboard.
ceb: Aron makita ang imong enrollment status mag login sa BukSU Admission gamit ang imong student ID ug password.
Human makasulod adto sa enrollment o registration section.
Makita didto ang imong enrollment status mga subject ug schedule sa dashboard.

en: To change your BukSU portal password log in to your account and go to account settings.
Select change password and enter your current password and new password.
Save the changes to update your password.
ceb: Aron mausab ang imong BukSU portal password mag login sa imong account ug adto sa account settings.
Pilia ang change password ug ibutang ang current ug bag ong password.
I save ang changes aron ma update ang imong password.

en: To qualify for the College of Education at Bukidnon State University, applicants must pass the BukSU College Admission Test.
The typical expected CAT score is around 80 or above.
However the final requirement may vary depending on the number of applicants, available slots, and the admission policies set by the university for that academic year.
ceb: Aron makasulod sa College of Education sa Bukidnon State University, kinahanglan makapasar ang aplikante sa BukSU College Admission Test.
Kasagaran ang gikinahanglan nga score kay mga 80 pataas.
Apan mahimo gihapon kini mag-usab depende sa kadaghan sa aplikante, available nga slots, ug sa admission policy sa unibersidad matag tuig.

en: If you forgot your BukSU portal password go to the BukSU Admission login page and click the Forgot Password option.
Enter the email address registered with your BukSU account.
The system will send instructions to your email so you can create a new password.
ceb: Kung nakalimot ka sa imong BukSU portal password adto sa BukSU Admission login page ug i click ang Forgot Password nga option.
Ibutang ang email address nga naka register sa imong BukSU account.
Magpadala ang system ug instructions sa imong email aron makabuhat ka ug bag ong password.

en: If your BukSU portal account is locked wait a few minutes and try logging in again.
Accounts may become locked after multiple incorrect login attempts.
If the problem continues contact the BukSU ICT support office or the registrar for assistance.
ceb: Kung na lock ang imong BukSU portal account hulata una ang pila ka minuto ug sulayi pag login pag usab.
Kasagaran ma lock ang account kung daghan na kaayo ug sayop nga login attempts.
Kung padayon gihapon ang problema kontaka ang BukSU ICT support o ang registrar aron matabangan ka.

en: You may not be able to log in to the BukSU Admission portal if the email or password is incorrect. It can also happen if your account is locked or if the portal is temporarily under maintenance. Check your login details carefully and try again.
ceb: Dili ka makasulod sa BukSU Admission portal kung sayop ang imong email o password. Mahimo usab kini kung na lock ang imong account o kung adunay maintenance ang portal. Siguroa nga sakto ang imong login details ug sulayi pag login pag usab.

en: Requirements for the Graduate Program Admission Test include a soft copy of a 2x2 ID picture.
You must also submit a scanned copy of your transcript of records.
Non BukSU graduates must submit an honorable dismissal.
A payment receipt is also required.
ceb: Ang mga kinahanglanon sa GPAT naglakip sa soft copy sa 2x2 ID picture.
Kinahanglan usab ang scanned copy sa transcript of records.
Para sa dili BukSU graduates kinahanglan ang honorable dismissal.
Kinahanglan usab ang payment receipt.

en: Yes BukSU offers evening programs specifically for working individuals particularly in the Graduate School including Masters and Doctorate degrees and in the College of Law.
Some undergraduate programs may also offer late afternoon or evening schedules depending on the department.
ceb: Oo ang BukSU nagtanyag og mga klase sa gabii para sa mga nagtrabaho ilabina sa Graduate School sama sa Masters ug Doctorate ug sa College of Law.
Ang uban nga undergraduate programs mahimo usab adunay klase sa hapon o gabii depende sa departamento.

en: For official updates announcements and schedules regarding admissions you can follow the BukSU Admission and Testing Unit Facebook page.
https://www.facebook.com/BukSUATU
ceb: Para sa opisyal nga update pahibalo ug mga schedule bahin sa admissions mahimo nimong i follow ang Facebook page nga BukSU Admission and Testing Unit.
https://www.facebook.com/BukSUATU

en: Changing your program choice is generally not allowed once the BukSU CAT application is submitted online.
Applicants are strongly advised to finalize their chosen program before clicking the submit button.
ceb: Kasagaran dili na pwede usabon ang napiling kurso kung na submit na ang BukSU CAT application online.
Girekomendar nga sigurohon una ang imong desisyon sa dili pa i click ang submit button.

en: Yes BukSU supports inclusivity and provides assistance for students with disabilities.
PWD applicants and students may coordinate with the Office of Student Services for assistance and reasonable accommodations during exams and classes.
ceb: Oo ang BukSU naghatag og importansya sa inclusivity ug naghatag og tabang para sa mga estudyante nga adunay disability.
Ang mga PWD nga aplikante o estudyante mahimong makig coordinate sa Office of Student Services para sa tabang ug espesyal nga accommodation sa exam o klase.

en: Continuing students must log in to the admissions portal.
Click proceed to account migration using the student number.
Fill in the required information verify the details and submit the application for evaluation.
ceb: Ang continuing students kinahanglan mag login sa admissions portal.
I click ang proceed to account migration gamit ang student number.
Human masulatan ang info i verify ug i submit ang application para ma process sa evaluator.

en: Students must wear the prescribed university uniform on designated days.
During civilian days students must still follow the modest dress code.
Shorts sleeveless tops ripped jeans and slippers are not allowed inside the campus.
ceb: Ang mga estudyante kinahanglan magsul ob sa saktong uniporme sa mga gitakdang adlaw.
Sa civilian days kinahanglan gihapon mosunod sa ligdong nga pamesti.
Bawal ang mag shorts mag sando gisi nga karsones ug mag tsinelas sulod sa campus.

en: Students can access BukSU library resources by presenting a valid BukSU ID.
For online resources students may log in to the library digital portal.
You may also visit the University Library to borrow physical books.
ceb: Mahimong magamit sa estudyante ang library resources pinaagi sa pagpakita sa valid BukSU ID.
Para sa online ebooks mahimong gamiton ang digital library portal.
Pwede usab moadto sa University Library para manghulam og mga libro.

en: If you miss your scheduled BukSU CAT exam date you should immediately contact the Admission and Testing Unit.
Rescheduling may be possible depending on the availability of slots and the validity of the reason.
ceb: Kung mapalabay nimo ang imong schedule sa BukSU CAT exam kontaka dayon ang Admission and Testing Unit.
Mahimong ma reschedule kini depende kung naay bakante nga slot ug balido ang imong rason.

en: Graduates of the Alternative Learning System or ALS are allowed to apply for the BukSU College Admission Test.
Applicants must provide their ALS Certificate of Rating and other required identification documents.
ceb: Ang mga graduate sa Alternative Learning System o ALS mahimong maka apply sa BukSU College Admission Test.
Kinahanglan i submit ang ALS Certificate of Rating ug uban pang identification requirements.

en: Yes the University Guidance and Counseling Unit provides services such as individual counseling career guidance and psychological testing.
These services support the mental health and well being of students.
ceb: Oo ang University Guidance and Counseling Unit naghatag og serbisyo sama sa individual counseling career guidance ug psychological testing.
Kini nga serbisyo nagasuporta sa mental health ug kaayohan sa mga estudyante.

en: BukSU uses a numerical grading system where 1.0 is the highest grade and 3.0 is the passing mark.
A grade of 5.0 means a failing mark while INC means the requirements for the subject are incomplete.
ceb: Ang BukSU naggamit og numerical grading system diin ang 1.0 ang pinakataas ug 3.0 ang passing mark.
Ang grado nga 5.0 nagpasabot nga wala kapasar samtang ang INC nagpasabot nga kulang ang requirements sa subject.

en: Under the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act tuition and miscellaneous fees are free for qualified Filipino students in undergraduate programs at BukSU.
ceb: Ubos sa balaod nga Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act libre ang tuition ug miscellaneous fees para sa mga kwalipikadong Filipino nga estudyante sa undergraduate programs sa BukSU.

en: Yes BukSU has sports facilities including a gymnasium basketball courts and open fields.
These facilities are used for PE classes intramurals and training of student athletes.
ceb: Oo ang BukSU adunay sports facilities sama sa gymnasium basketball courts ug open fields.
Gigamit kini para sa PE classes intramurals ug training sa mga student athletes.

en: Yes you can use a mobile phone to access the admission portal.
However using a desktop or laptop is recommended when uploading documents like photos and certificates to avoid technical errors.
ceb: Oo pwede gamiton ang mobile phone para sa admission portal.
Apan mas maayo kung mogamit og desktop o laptop para mas sayon ang pag upload sa mga dokumento ug malikayan ang mga technical error.

en: The list of undergraduate and graduate programs can be found on the official BukSU website under the Academics section.
You may also inquire directly at the Admission and Testing Unit for the list of available courses.
ceb: Ang listahan sa mga kurso makita sa opisyal nga website sa BukSU sa Academics nga section.
Mahimo usab mangutana diretso sa Admission and Testing Unit para sa listahan sa mga kurso.

en: Students who want to become Student Assistants may apply through the Office of Student Services.
Requirements usually include the required GWA a copy of the current study load and proof of financial need.
ceb: Ang mga estudyante nga gusto mahimong Student Assistant mahimong mo apply sa Office of Student Services.
Ang mga kinahanglanon kasagaran naglakip sa gikinahanglan nga GWA kopya sa study load ug pamatuod sa financial need.

en: Smart BukSU is a strategic roadmap launched under the administration of Dr Joy M Mirasol.
It focuses on digital transformation innovative instruction sustainable infrastructure and improved student services through technology.
ceb: Ang Smart BukSU usa ka strategic roadmap nga gilunsad ubos sa pagdumala ni Dr Joy M Mirasol.
Nagtutok kini sa digital transformation innovative nga pagtudlo malungtarong imprastraktura ug mas maayong serbisyo para sa mga estudyante pinaagi sa teknolohiya.

en: Students can borrow a maximum of five books per week from the BukSU Library.
Borrowers must present a barcoded library card.
Some materials like reserve books encyclopedias and theses are only for inside reading and photocopying.
ceb: Ang mga estudyante pwede mohulam og hangtod lima ka libro matag semana sa BukSU Library.
Kinahanglan ipakita ang barcoded library card.
Ang ubang materyales sama sa reserve books encyclopedias ug thesis para lamang sa inside reading o photocopy.

en: Students who fail to return borrowed materials on time will face fines.
For books rented from the Book Center for a semester the penalty for unreturned items is one hundred pesos.
ceb: Ang mga estudyante nga mapakyas sa pag uli sa mga libro sa saktong oras multahan.
Para sa mga libro gikan sa Book Center ang multa sa wala nauli nga libro kay usa ka gatus ka pesos.

en: The Office of Student Services practices a No Noon Break Policy.
This means staff members remain available even during lunch time to provide continuous frontline services to students.
ceb: Ang Office of Student Services nagpatuman og No Noon Break Policy.
Nagpasabot kini nga adunay staff nga available bisan sa oras sa paniudto aron mapadayon ang serbisyo sa mga estudyante.

en: The institution was originally established in 1924 as a secondary school which later evolved into Bukidnon State University.
ceb: Ang institusyon natukod niadtong 1924 isip usa ka secondary school nga sa ulahi nahimong Bukidnon State University.

en: BukSU is composed of several colleges including the:
- College of Arts and Sciences
- College of Education
- College of Business
- College of Nursing
- College of Technologies
- College of Public Administration and Governance
- College of Law
ceb: Ang BukSU gilangkuban sa pipila ka mga kolehiyo lakip ang:
- College of Arts and Sciences
- College of Education
- College of Business
- College of Nursing
- College of Technologies
- College of Public Administration and Governance
- College of Law

en: The year 1924 marks the founding of the Bukidnon Farm School which is the historical origin of Bukidnon State University.
ceb: Ang tuig 1924 mao ang pagkatukod sa Bukidnon Farm School nga gigikanan sa karon nga Bukidnon State University.

en: Dasig is the official spirit animal of Bukidnon State University.
It was launched in February 2026 to represent the modern brand identity and heritage of the university.
ceb: Ang Dasig mao ang opisyal nga spirit animal sa Bukidnon State University.
Gilunsad kini niadtong Pebrero 2026 aron magrepresentar sa modernong brand identity ug kabilin sa unibersidad.

en: Republic Act 9454 which converted Bukidnon State College into Bukidnon State University was authored and sponsored by Juan Miguel Zubiri when he was a Congressman.

en: For the school year 2020-2021, BukSU-CAT has two rating status: “Passed” or “Failed”.
In order to be enrolled in BukSU, the exam taker must obtain at least 40% (passing rate).
Exam takers who obtained rating below the passing rate will not be admitted.
For board courses like Education, Nursing and Accountancy, their colleges require 50% and above BukSU-CAT rating.
The validity of the exam is for one year.
No retake is allowed within a year from the date of the exam.
HOWEVER this are old data so it might be change in every year, you can directly ask the Public Help Disk which is located on the entrance of BukSU.
ceb: Para sa school year 2020-2021, ang BukSU-CAT adunay duha ka rating status: “Passed” o “Failed”.
Aron maka-enroll sa BukSU, ang exam taker kinahanglan makakuha og labing menos 40% (passing rate).
Ang mga exam taker nga nakakuha og rating ubos sa passing rate dili pasudlon.
Para sa board courses sama sa Education, Nursing, ug Accountancy, ang ilang kolehiyo nagkinahanglan og 50% ug pataas nga BukSU-CAT rating.
Ang validity sa exam kay usa ka tuig lamang.
Dili pwede mag-retake sulod sa usa ka tuig gikan sa petsa sa exam.

en: Bukidnon State University started in 1924 as the Bukidnon Farm School.
In 1928 it became Bukidnon Secondary Normal School.
In 1976 it was converted into Bukidnon State College through Presidential Decree 944.
It became Bukidnon State University on June 15 2007 under Republic Act 9454.
ceb: Ang Bukidnon State University nagsugod niadtong 1924 isip Bukidnon Farm School.
Niadtong 1928 nahimo kini nga Bukidnon Secondary Normal School.
Sa 1976 nahimo kini nga Bukidnon State College pinaagi sa Presidential Decree 944.
Nahimo kini nga Bukidnon State University niadtong June 15 2007 ubos sa Republic Act 9454.

en: How can I take the BukSU College Admission Test?
Follow these steps to apply for the BukSU College Admission Test:
Step 1: Access http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph. Register using your active Gmail account. Create your password and re-type it for verification.
Step 2: After creating an account, an email containing a confirmation link will be sent to your Gmail. Check your inbox and click the link to activate your account.
Step 3: Fill out all the necessary information and upload the documentary requirements.
Step 4: Select your preferred schedule (venue, date, and time) based on the availability of slots.
Step 5: You will get notifications once your application is accepted. download and print your Test Permit.
ceb: Unsaon nako pagkuha sa BukSU College Admission Test?
Sunod kining mga lakang aron mag-apply sa BukSU College Admission Test:
Step 1: Bisitaha ang http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph. Mag-register gamit ang imong active nga Gmail account. Himoa ang imong password ug i-type pag-usab para sa verification.
Step 2: Human makahimo og account, usa ka email nga adunay confirmation link ipadala sa imong Gmail. Tan-awa ang imong inbox ug i-klik ang link aron ma-activate ang imong account.
Step 3: Pun-a ang tanan nga kinahanglan nga impormasyon ug i-upload ang mga documentary requirements.
Step 4: Pilia ang imong preferred schedule (venue, petsa, ug oras) base sa available nga slots.
Step 5: Makadawat ka og notifications kung gi-accept ang imong aplikasyon. i-download ug i-print ang imong Test Permit.

follow_up: Make sure all your information and documents are correct to avoid delays in your application.
Keep track of your preferred schedule and check your email regularly for notifications.

en: Assignments may be submitted via email or through platforms like Google Classroom, depending on your instructor's preference. To submit via Google Classroom:
1. Open the specific subject with the pending assignment.
2. If you can’t find it, tap the Menu (three lines) on the top left and select 'To-do.'
3. Select the assignment, attach your file, and click 'Turn in.
4. Once the status changes to 'Turned in,' your submission is complete.
ceb: Ang mga assignment pwede ipasa pinaagi sa email o sa mga platform sama sa Google Classroom, depende sa gusto sa inyong instructor. Para mopasa gamit ang Google Classroom:

2. Kung dili nimo makita, i-tap ang Menu (tulo ka linya) sa ibabaw nga wala ug pilia ang 'To-do'.
3. Pilia ang assignment, i-attach ang imong file, ug i-click ang 'Turn in'.
4. Kung mausab na ang status ngadto sa 'Turned in', kumpleto na ang imong submission.

en: To qualify for the College of Nursing at Bukidnon State University, applicants must pass the BukSU College Admission Test.
The expected CAT score is usually around 80 to 90 or above because the program has limited slots and high demand.
However, the required CAT score may vary depending on the number of applicants, available slots, and the admission policies set by the university for that academic year.
ceb: Aron makasulod sa College of Nursing sa Bukidnon State University, kinahanglan makapasar ang aplikante sa BukSU College Admission Test.
Kasagaran ang gikinahanglan nga score kay mga 80 to 90 pataas tungod kay limitado ang slots ug daghan ang aplikante.
Apan ang required nga CAT score mahimong mag-usab depende sa kadaghan sa aplikante, available nga slots, ug sa admission policy sa unibersidad matag tuig.

en: An INC (Incomplete) grade means you still have missing requirements for the subject.

en: Here are the requirements you need before applying for BukSU Admission Testing:
1. You need to have your own personal Gmail account to create an account on BukSU Admissions: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/

2. You need a digital copy of your 2x2 photo. Please make sure your photo meets the following specifications: plain white background, wearing a white T-shirt, no accessories, and the correct 2x2 size.
For documentary requirements:

Report card, Transcript of Records, Principal’s Certification, GWA, and Diploma. These are optional as long as you have the Principal’s Certification. Make sure it is signed by your principal and properly sealed.
After applying for BukSU Admission, please wait for approval.
Note: Your Gmail should be accessible, as all verification codes will be sent there.
ceb: Ania ang mga kinahanglanon nga imong andamon sa dili pa mag-apply para sa BukSU Admission Testing:
1. Kinahanglan naa kay personal nga Gmail account aron makahimo og account sa BukSU Admissions: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/

2. Kinahanglan pud ka og digital copy sa imong 2x2 nga litrato. Siguroa nga ang imong litrato mosunod sa mosunod nga specifications: puti nga background, nagsul-ob og puti nga T-shirt, walay accessories, ug sakto nga 2x2 nga size.
Para sa documentary requirements:

Report card, Transcript of Records, Principal’s Certification, GWA, ug Diploma. Optional ra kini basta naa kay Principal’s Certification. Siguroa nga pirmado kini sa imong principal ug sakto ang pag-seal.
Human ka mag-apply para sa BukSU Admission, palihog hulata ang approval.
Note: Siguroa nga ma-access nimo ang imong Gmail, kay didto ipadala ang tanang verification codes.

en: If you’re a freshman, you need to bring your Report of Ratings (ROR) and your application form, which can be downloaded from your BukSU Admission account.
You should also bring your birth certificate, report card (a photocopy is fine if you don’t have the original), LRN, diploma, and good moral certificate.
After that, you can proceed to the department where you want to enroll.
For those enrolling in the 2nd semester, you just need to apply for online enrollment for your continuing course and then proceed to the faculty to process your enrollment.
ceb: Kung ikaw usa ka freshman, kinahanglan nimo dad-on ang imong Report of Ratings (ROR) ug ang imong application form, nga pwede nimo i-download gikan sa imong BukSU Admission account.
Kinahanglan usab nimo dad-on ang birth certificate, report card (pwede ang photocopy kung wala kay original), LRN, diploma, ug good moral certificate.
Human niini, mahimo ka na moadto sa departamento nga imong gustong sudlan.
Para sa mga mo-enroll sa 2nd semester, kinahanglan lang nga mag-apply sa online enrollment para sa imong padayon nga kurso, unya adtoa ang faculty aron iproseso ang imong enrollment.

en: To clear your enrollment for graduation, you must first secure a University Clearance Form from the Office of the Registrar or your respective College Dean.

This form requires official signatures from key offices, including the University Library (to confirm all borrowed books are returned), the Office of the Student Services (OSS), and the Cashier or Accounting Office to ensure all tuition and graduation fees (such as diploma, alumni, and legacy fees) are fully paid.

Additionally, you must submit vital documents to the Registrar, such as your PSA Birth Certificate, original High School Report Card (Form 138/137) or Transcript of Records (for transferees), and an Affidavit of Loss if you cannot surrender your Student ID.
Once all signatures are collected and requirements are submitted, your name will be included in the final list of candidates for graduation.
ceb: Aron ma-clear ang imong enrollment para sa graduation sa BukSU, kinahanglan nimo nga makompleto ang University Clearance.
Sugdan kini pinaagi sa pagkuha og clearance form gikan sa Office of the Registrar o sa opisina sa imong Dean.

Kinahanglan nimo kining papirmahan sa nagkalain-lain nga mga opisina sama sa Library (siguruha nga wala kay wala na-uli nga libro), sa Office of the Student Services (OSS), ug sa Cashier o Accounting aron pamatud-an nga bayad na ang imong tuition ug graduation fees (sama sa diploma fee ug alumni fee).
Kinahanglan usab nimo isumite sa Registrar ang mga dokumento sama sa imong PSA Birth Certificate, orihinal nga Report Card o TOR, ug Affidavit of Loss kung nawala ang imong Student ID.
Kon makompleto na ang tanang pirma ug requirements, ang imong ngalan opisyal na nga i-apil sa listahan sa mga mo-graduate.

en: What are the services offered in the University Guidance Center?
The services that the UGC offers the following services:

Counseling Services: Counseling is considered as the core of guidance services. It aims to assist the students in their emotional, social, physical, spiritual, and cognitive needs. During this time of pandemic the University Guidance Center offers online counselling so that the guidance counselors can reach out to students easier and use the online platform to cater their personal issues, problems and concerns.

Career and Job Placement Services: It is a support service of the University Guidance Center, it aims to address the pre-employment and employment needs of the graduating students and alumnae. The UGC schedules an annual Job Fair. Various agencies and company are invited to take part of the school’s on-campus recruitment program. The UGC offers career seminars and orientation that cater the needs of the students.

Testing Services: The student’s individual strength and weaknesses in the area of personality, IQ and aptitude are assessed through the use of standardized tests. This is handled by the psychometricians. The center provides; Psychological testing for students and testing of faculty and staff applicants.
Exit Interview: The graduating students are given an opportunity to discuss their future plans, career choices and various options for employment.
ceb: Unsa ang mga serbisyo nga gitanyag sa University Guidance Center?
Ang UGC nagatanyag sa mosunod nga mga serbisyo:

Counseling Services: Ang counseling mao ang pinakauyok sa mga serbisyo sa guidance. Tumong niini nga tabangan ang mga estudyante sa ilang emosyonal, sosyal, pisikal, espiritwal, ug panghunahuna nga panginahanglan. Niining panahon sa pandemya, nagtanyag ang UGC og online counseling aron mas dali maabot sa mga counselor ang mga estudyante gamit ang online platform para sa ilang personal nga mga isyu ug problema.

Career and Job Placement Services: Kini usa ka support service sa UGC nga nagtinguha sa pagtubag sa mga panginahanglanon sa pre-employment ug trabaho sa mga mogradwar nga estudyante ug alumni. Ang UGC nag-iskedyul og tinuig nga Job Fair diin lain-laing ahensya ug kompanya ang imbitahon. Nagtanyag usab sila og career seminars ug orientation.

Testing Services: Ang tagsa-tagsa ka kusog ug kahuyang sa estudyante sa aspeto sa personalidad, IQ, ug aptitude ginasusi pinaagi sa standardized tests nga gidumala sa mga psychometrician. Naghatag usab sila og psychological testing para sa mga aplikante nga faculty ug staff.
Exit Interview: Ang mga mogradwar nga estudyante hatagan og higayon nga hisgutan ang ilang mga plano sa umaabot, pagpili sa karera, ug mga opsyon sa trabaho.
